user.title: Bulgaria power outages
user.description: Choose the electricity distribution operator of the address to monitor.

erm_zapad.title: ЕРМ Запад
erm_zapad.description: What to monitor. A client number is exact and also reports unplanned outages; a place uses the daily planned schedules and is only indicative.

client.title: Client number
client.description: The 12-digit client number from the electricity bill. Add each client number separately.

data_description.client_number: 12 digits, e.g. 300000000000. Metering points (32Z…) are not supported.

place.title: Place to monitor
place.description: Name of the place as written in the ЕРМ Запад daily schedules (Cyrillic, case does not matter). It is matched as a substring of the place names in the schedule, e.g. ЗЛАТУША, ОБЕЛЯ, ГОРНА БАНЯ.

data_description.place: Village, town or quarter, e.g. ЗЛАТУША.
data_description.district: Narrows the match when the name exists in several municipalities, e.g. БОЖУРИЩЕ. For Sofia this is the district (ВРЪБНИЦА, ОВЧА КУПЕЛ). Needed for unplanned outages.

evn.title: Place to monitor – Електроразпределение Юг
evn.description: The province and a word that appears in the published description of the affected area, usually the name of the town or village (Cyrillic, case does not matter). Planned and unplanned outages are covered; both are only indicative.

data_description.place: Matched as a substring of the description, e.g. РАВАДИНОВО or СОЗОПОЛ.
data_description.text: Must also appear in the description, e.g. ОДЕСА. Leave empty to be told about every outage in the place.

erp_sever.title: Place to monitor – Електроразпределение Север
erp_sever.description: The province and a word that appears in the published description of the affected area, usually the name of the town or village (Cyrillic, case does not matter). Only planned outages are published; they are indicative.

data_description.place: Matched as a substring of the description, e.g. ВАРНА or ОСЕНОВО.
data_description.text: Must also appear in the description, e.g. БРЕГАЛНИЦА. Leave empty to be told about every outage in the place.

reconfigure.title: Change the monitored target
reconfigure.description: Enter a new client number or place (same operator and kind as before: {operator}).

data_description.district: Narrows the match when the name exists in several municipalities, e.g. БОЖУРИЩЕ. Needed for unplanned outages.
data_description.text: Must also appear in the description of the affected area.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the operator's website.
error.rate_limited: The operator refused the request (request limit reached). Try again later.
error.invalid_client_number: The client number must have exactly 12 digits.
error.unknown_client_number: ЕРМ Запад does not know this client number. Check it on the electricity bill.

abort.already_configured: This client number or place is already configured.

unrecognised_answer.title: {operator} answer not understood ({title})
